items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: No, I don't know. Jim Thomas. No, I don't know. Probably not. He was really good, but he wasn't much of a music man.

ctx.x: That's not the guy they call brother Cornbread, is it?
No, I don't know. Jim Thomas. No, I don't know. Probably not. He was really good, but he wasn't much of a music man. He was a rope man.
I don't know about it. And he used to play with your son then, huh?
